author: Fgbvcfnmb
title: Functions not working!
content:
After last update, photo function not working properly if using a tablet and use in the Landscape orientation which is how I hold mine to take pictures.  Works fine in portrait position, but when trying to take a picture holding tablet in Landscape position - about a third of the view on the RH Side is lost, and the shutter button position remains at the bottom center, can’t reach with your thumb to snap picture! ( I have big hands)! Prior to last update, shutter button would be on RH side within thumbs reach which allowed for a steadier grip to hold tablet for better pictures.
Also the previous inspection notes and pictures showing up is nice, but would be really awesome if you could cut and paste pictures from previous inspection to be able to show side by side previous damage next to current repaired status.

author: chiefdarkcloud
title: A field inspector
content:
This APP is full of problems.  I get multiple ‘white screen events’ every day. The screen turns solid white and locks up the APP. I must delete & reinstall the APP in order to free the lock up. Of course all ‘in progress inspection’ info is lost, so must start over again.  On a daily basis This APP has frozen up at different screens on ‘in progress inspections’ —- each time all entered info was lost.   One would think that any entered information or pictures during an ‘in progress inspection’ would be saved as one progresses through the inspection so that if the APP froze up, or cell / internet connection was interrupted the INSPECTION info could be retrieved. Apparently this is not the case. If I did not HAVE to use this APP I WOULD NOT !!!   EXTREMELY FRUSTRATING !!!  I expected more from CAT.

The ‘REPORTS’ PDF load time is painfully long in duration. The amount of time it takes for a ‘SUBMITTED’ inspection to be generated in to a ‘REPORT’ is ridiculous in today’s world — should be almost instantaneously generated.  This tells me that there are ‘batching’ issues in the program code.

My TD AMERITRADE stock trading APP works flawlessly!  The amount of data the TD AMERITRADE APP handles is many multiples of the CAT INSPECT APP and it is provided in REAL TIME, and it has worked for me since 2018 without a hiccup. Why does CAT INSPECT APP (a simple data storage / data retrieval platform) have so many issues?
